fact: The Ghana Statistical Service announced a Pilot Register-Based Education Statistics Project, discussed on 22 July 2026 with the Ministry of Education, Ghana Education Service and National Identification Authority, to produce education statistics continuously from administrative records and track learners.

The Ministry of Education completed a review of Education Management Information System indicators at a 17-18 December 2025 workshop, and stakeholders agreed to integrate the revised indicators into the next national school census.

The GPE programme proposal says Ghana has a functioning Education Management Information System, digitalized since 2022 and disaggregated by sex and disability, collecting data for only 104 of 124 indicators, as confirmed by the ITAP review.

The Ministry of Education's PMDV Dashboard API documentation lists an EMIS schools statistics endpoint returning school counts by level and public or private status, with regional and district filters, and an enrolment rates endpoint.
